description: This file defines the HTMLPurifier_TokenFactory class, which provides methods to generate various HTML purification tokens by cloning prototypes and initializing them. It includes methods for creating start, end, empty, text, and comment tokens, optimizing token creation performance through cloning.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_TokenFactory
classes.description: Factory class for generating HTML tokens efficiently using cloning of prototypes.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes prototype tokens for different token types.

methods.name: createStart
methods.description: Creates a new start token by cloning the start token prototype and initializing it.

methods.name: createEnd
methods.description: Creates a new end token by cloning the end token prototype and initializing it.

methods.name: createEmpty
methods.description: Creates a new empty token by cloning the empty token prototype and initializing it.

methods.name: createText
methods.description: Creates a new text token by cloning the text token prototype and initializing it.

methods.name: createComment
methods.description: Creates a new comment token by cloning the comment token prototype and initializing it.
